title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Targeted response to essential needs of affected communities in Kachin State and South East Myanmar programme is implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 1.1: Duty-bearers have taken actions to respect and protect rights. The activities and objective include, Establish and/or strengthen community-based groups working on documenting, monitoring and reporting on access to justice or resource right violations and taking action and capacity building of access to justice defenders. So, at-risk women and men and their defenders, especially women and women access to justice defenders, are taking action to claim and defend rights. Programmes are in partnership [redacted]. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 1.1 Duty-bearers have taken actions to respect and protect rights. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this outcome is:- Advocacy for the protection of human rights; in particular natural resource rights- Work under this outcome has a specific focus on women and women human rights defender
